title.zh: 24日22:10UTC扫描：无新官方死失踪分项
title.en: 24 Sep 22:10UTC scan: no newer official casualty split

body.zh: 新华/应急部无新拆分。MEM 18日仅口岸562死亡失踪合计。KPI仍用中方5日18时43/519/2、尼方23日19:00NPT 1453/5644/13795。国门关闭；堰塞湖已排空。NDRRMA今日仅降雨与河道水位预警。无新SitRep。
body.en: No new Xinhua/MEM split. MEM 18 Sep only combined 562 dead+missing at port. KPI still CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2 and NP 23 Sep 19:00 NPT 1453/5644/13795. Gate closed; lake drained. NDRRMA today: rain and river-level alert only. No new SitRep.
body.ne: Xinhua/MEM naya split chain. MEM 18 Sep 562 jog. KPI CN 43/519/2, NP 1453/5644/13795. Gate band; tal khali. Aaja barsa/nadi matra. Naya SitRep chain.
body.hi: Xinhua/MEM naya split nahi. MEM 18 Sep 562 yog. KPI CN 43/519/2, NP 1453/5644/13795. Gate band; jheel khali. Aaj barish/nadi hi. Naya SitRep nahi.

title.hi: NDRRMA: 12 ghante barish; kuch nadiyan uchi

body.hi: Kahi bhari barish. Casualty nahi. Savdhan rahen.

title.en: NDRRMA 23 Sep 19:00 NPT: 1453 dead, 5644 missing, 13795 rescued

body.zh: 官方图。失踪已扣移交遗体112具。636外籍失联。勿与中方相加。
body.en: Official graphic. Missing after 112 handed-over bodies deducted. 636 foreign missing. Do not add CN.

body.hi: Graphic. 112 shav kate. 636 videshi. CN na joden.

body.en: Official X posted #22. KPI from same-day graphic 1453/5644/13795. No #23 this run.

body.en: Trishuli–Betrawati riverbank washed out. Single-lane dirt detour toward Syafrubesi. Rasuwagadhi access still badly damaged.

body.hi: Trishuli–Betrawati sadak bahi. Syafrubesi ek-lane mitti. Rasuwagadhi kshatigrast.

body.zh: 正在进一步核查。未拆分死/失联。勿把562当新增分项。
body.en: Still under verification. No split. Do not treat 562 as a new split.
body.ne: Jaanch jari. Split chain. 562 naya hoina.
body.hi: Jaanch jari. Split nahi. 562 naya nahi.

body.hi: CN split. 261 videshi, 23 desh. Naya split nahi.
